newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican newspaper slams Polish abortion bill.
newsitem.headline: Vatican newspaper slams Polish abortion bill.

text.p: The Vatican angrily denounced passage by the Polish parliament on Thursday of a bill liberalising abortion, saying the country had "chosen the path of death".
The semi-official newspaper L'Osservatore Romano launched the attack in an article in its latest edition which noted previous appeals by Pope John Paul, a Pole, for the legislation not to be adopted.
"With the liberalisation of abortion...Poland has taken a decisive step forward towards the culture of death," the article said.

It said Polish legislators had assumed a "very grave responsibility, setting themselves up as arbiters of the life of all those unwanted human beings who, thus, can now be supressed with the benefit of the law".

Poland's lower house, the Sejm, on Thursday overthrew a Senate veto and passed the bill liberalising abortion, which ex-communist President Aleksander Kwasniewski has promised to sign promptly into law.

L'Osservatore Romano said the Pope had recently urged Poles to pray that the right to life from conception to death would be respected in their country. "A nation that kills its own children is a nation without a future," the Pope had said.
